title: 機械力学
subtitle: Dynamics of Machines
educationalGoal: Dynamics of Machines is a part of the subject mechanics which is the basis of mechanical engineering. Students will learn the motions of mass points and rigid bodies due to external force or torque.
advice: Students will learn the meanings of mathematical formulas and gain understanding by solving exercises. We will cover the following materials: 1. Momentum, impulse, law of conservation of momentum, and collision 2. Work and energy 3. Law of conservation of mechanical energy 4. Loss of kinetic energy by collision 5. Power 6. Friction
books: Same as "Engineering Mechanics I", and "Engineering Mechanics II."
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Engineering mechanics I and II Sufficient skill in mathematics

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the meaning of terms.
Be able to not only use but also derive formulas
Be able to derive the equations of motion
Be able to apply mathematics to the derived equations of motion and explain their dynamic behavior.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
